title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Strong thunderstorms are expected for today

---Discussion---

Thunderstorms will be significant, mainly in the stretch Austria - W Slovakia - Far S Poland.
These thunderstorms will be capable of producing wind gusts up to 120km/h with hail up to 4cm.

More unsignificant thunderstorm activity is expected for NW Germany, and Czechia which may get weaker short-lived thunderstorms.
